optimal_center: if A0>0, r=A1/A0 annihilates the residual square and D2=A0[A2-A1^2/A0]
certification: choose a rational r near the total slope, interval-enclose the two sector centered terms and residual A1-rA0; this remains valid when one sector zeroth moment is negative
advantage: the only division is optional center selection performed from a prior enclosure; the certified identity itself is polynomial
hostile_condition: if A0<=0 the rank-one Hankel gate already fails or is degenerate, so no variance interpretation is authorized
acceptance_test: Using outward-rounded source values, certify A0>0 and choose a rational common center r whose centered coupled lower bound makes A0*C_r exceed (A1-rA0)^2 over the target (t,h) point or cell.
